units.source_text: [\[18\]](#part1331.html#w18) 白居易《秦中吟》十首之一《议婚》：

en.t: Note 18: In one of the ten poems in Bai Juyi's Qinzhong Yin, titled On Marriage, it says:
The host invites a good matchmaker and fills the jade flask with wine.

units.source_text: 四座且勿饮，听我歌两途：

en.t: All of you seated here, do not drink yet; listen while I sing of two different paths:

units.source_text: 富家女易嫁，嫁早轻其夫；

en.t: A rich family's daughter is easy to marry off, but when she marries early she looks down on her husband;

units.source_text: 贫家女难嫁，嫁晚孝于姑。

en.t: A poor family's daughter is hard to marry off, but when she marries late she serves her mother-in-law with filial care.
And so the quotation continues, then is omitted here.
